role: The chest model used by TileEntityChestRenderer and the item renderer: lid, knob and bottom boxes on a 64x64 texture.
scope_reason: Chests are in scope; their item/block model geometry is ported, but the in-world lid-angle renderer is not.

members.name: ModelChest
members.note: the three boxes and their rotation points are unfolded into block coordinates (block_item_model.c:142-144)

notes: The world chest (raster_tileent.c model_chest: renderAll's lid, knob and bottom, the knob taking the lid's angle, each ModelRenderer.render with its translate and translate back) and the item icon (block_item_model.c chest_box).
